More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Around the nation Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Multimedia center Tax articles to share Posters to share IRS announces tax relief for South Dakota victims of severe storms, tornadoes and flooding SD-2019-04, November 19, 2019 IRS announces tax relief for Texas victims of Tropical Storm Imelda TX− 2019-12, Oct. 7, 2019 - Victims of Tropical Storm Imelda that took place from Sept. 17-23, 2019 in Texas may qualify for tax relief from the Internal Revenue Service. IRS relief provides drought-stricken farmers, ranchers more time to replace livestock IR-2019-161, September 30, 2019 — Farmers and ranchers who were forced to sell livestock due to drought may have an additional year to replace the livestock and defer tax on any gains from the forced sales, according to the IRS. IRS announces tax relief for victims of severe storms, straight-line winds, tornadoes and flooding in Mississippi MS-2019-02, Sept. 24, 2019 IRS announces tax relief for Texas victims of severe storms and flooding TX-2019-02, July 18, 2019 — Victims of the severe storms and flooding that took place on June 24-25, 2019 in Texas may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. IRS announces tax relief for Missouri victims of severe storms, tornadoes and flooding MO-2019-01, July 11, 2019 IRS announces tax relief for Ohio victims of severe storms, straight-line winds, tornadoes, flooding, and landslides OH-2019-01, June 19, 2019 IRS announces tax relief for Arkansas victims of severe storms and flooding AR-2019-01, June 11, 2019 IRS announces tax relief for South Dakota victims of winter storm, snowstorm and flooding SD-2019-01, June 11, 2019 IRS announces tax relief for Oklahoma victims of severe storms, tornadoes, straight-line winds, and flooding OK-2019-01, June 3, 2019 — Victims of the severe storms, tornadoes, straight-line winds, and flooding that took place on May 7, 2019 in Oklahoma may qualify for tax relief from the Internal Revenue Service. IRS announces tax relief for Iowa victims of severe storms and flooding IA-2019-02, March 25, 2019 — Victims of the severe storms and flooding that took place on March 12, 2019 in Iowa may qualify for tax relief from the Internal Revenue Service. IRS announces tax relief for Nebraska victims of severe winter storm, straight-line winds, and flooding NE-2019-02, March 22, 2019 — Victims of the severe winter storm, straight-line winds, and flooding that took place on March 9, 2019 in Nebraska may qualify for tax relief from the Internal Revenue Service. IRS extends April 15, other upcoming deadlines for Alabama storm victims, provides other tax relief IR-2019-31, March 7, 2019 — Victims of Sunday’s tornadoes and severe storms in Alabama have until July 31, 2019, to file certain individual and business tax returns and make certain tax payments, the IRS announced today. IRS announces tax relief for Alabama victims of severe storms, tornadoes and straight-line winds AL-2019-01, March 7, 2019 Tax Relief for victims of earthquake in Alaska AK-2019-01, February 5, 2019 — Victims of the earthquake that took place on Nov. 30, 2018 in Alaska may qualify for tax relief from the IRS. Around the nation Get IRS news in your local area, particularly state-specific information about disaster relief and tax provisions. This page is designated as historical and is no longer updated.
